inputs.text: Locked-off 9:16 full-body shot using the uploaded photo as an unchanged image plate. Opening beat: the entire person is intact, standing exactly where they are, with the original background and floor perfectly still. Then one large realistic manicured hand enters from the upper-right foreground and pinches the crown of the person's hair/head, never covering the face. The person is a flat printed 2D die-cut sticker adhered to the image plane. The hand physically peels the sticker downward from the crown, creating a clear horizontal peel edge that travels across the shoulders and torso; the person's face, hair, clothing, pose, and proportions remain printed on one continuous flat sheet. The hand pulls the fully detached sticker toward the camera, briefly showing its pale white paper backside, then holds the front of the sticker up close. Keep the revealed background exactly unchanged and frozen. One continuous physical peel action, realistic fingers and sticker edge, vertical social video.
